title: Find Your Happy Place

style_bible.emotional_arc: Despair in isolation, hope in connection, understanding of self-worth through context.

style_bible.lighting: Moody twilight for isolation; shifting to softer, warmer light as the poem progresses towards acceptance.
style_bible.motif: A solitary figure in various landscapes representing different places, a book symbolizing personal growth, a path leading through each scene.
